namespaces.fingerprintRule: namespace seed must never collide with holdout seed
namespace seed must never collide with baseline seed

disjointnessAssertion: for any (industry, size, idx), baselineSeed(industry,size,idx) ≠ holdoutSeed(industry,size,idx) AND baselineProjectId ≠ holdoutProjectId. The seedPrefix values (106816=0x1A0C0 and 176337=0x2B1D1) are chosen so that no two seeds collide across namespaces for any valid (industry, size, idx) triple.
